programs.description: Malaikottai Vaaliban, an ageing warrior, returns to his village only to discover it has been overrun by colonisers. He challenges them to a fight, vowing to restore freedom.
Parthasarathy is well-loved by the people around him as he constantly works for their welfare. Soon, he falls in love with the daughter of his rival, unaware that she has an ulterior motive.
Three inseparable friends devise an ingenious ploy to fund a destitute woman's marriage. However, destiny plays a cruel game after an unscrupulous individual steal their hard-earned funds.
Two orphans cause mischief to earn their daily bread, but their lives change when a woman seeks their help to save her brother.
Two friends who hail from cinema industry and pursue two separate dreams, navigate through different phase of their life, both hilarious and sentimental.
Celebrity contestants live in an isolated house and perform assigned tasks, in order to win the cash prize, while also trying to avoid being eliminated.
Anjana Nambiar, the host, converses with former 'Bigg Boss' contestants to explore their side of the story, address controversies or regrets, and share post-game reflections.
A middle-class family's happiness is shattered by the sudden death of the father, Aravindan. Now, his daughters must navigate life's conflicts to find a path to hope.
Revathy is a young middle class woman trying to support her family. However, her life changes when she crosses paths with Sachi, an arrogant young man.
Nidhi wants to escape her destiny, so she marries into a family with a bad reputation. But, in this process she will either bring back their lost hope or lose her own.
The relentlessly courageous Anjali takes on a threatening case, with justice on her mind. As the case unravels, so do hidden truths and family betrayals.
